integrity: Finite exact checks are corroboration; the Stirling-ratio proof supplies the infinite argument. No independent review or publication priority is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Uniform labeled Cayley trees n>=4; exact conditioning on 2<=L<=n-1; does not extend to arbitrary tree laws. A more general classical occupancy-order theorem may subsume the comparison and must be checked before claiming historical priority.
title: More leaves force a strict convex-order spread of degrees in uniform labeled trees
